label: worktree setup: copy .worktreeinclude files
args: cd "$ZED_MAIN_GIT_WORKTREE" || exit 0; [ -f .worktreeinclude ] || exit 0; grep -v '^#' .worktreeinclude | grep -v '^$' | while read -r pat; do for f in $pat; do [ -f "$f" ] && mkdir -p "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/$(dirname "$f")" && cp "$f" "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/$f"; done; done; exit 0
